^DEPS_RUST_SHOP_CALLERS_ISSUERS_(0|[1-9].description: The algorithms the issuer signs with, comma-separated: RS256, ES256 or EdDSA.
The aud a token of the issuer must hold: this server.
The number of the issuer's callers, at least 1.
The APIs a caller serves, comma-separated, which an operation's from is checked against.
The subject claim's value that names a caller.
Other iss values of the issuer, comma-separated, such as Google's accounts.google.com.
Where the issuer publishes its keys; an issuer has it or KEYS, not both.
The number of the issuer's keys, at least 1, when it lists them rather than JWKS_URL.
A key of the issuer: a public JWK's JSON, with its kid. A key has JWK or PEM, not both.
A key of the issuer: an Ed25519 public key's SubjectPublicKeyInfo PEM, whose kid is its RFC 7638 thumbprint (D63). A key has JWK or PEM, not both.
The longest a token of the issuer may live, from its iat to its exp, in whole seconds above 0.
The claim that names the caller; sub when unset.

envVars.name: DEPS_MEDIA_BUCKET
envVars.description: The bucket connection of deps-media (buckets), one variable per member.

envVars.name: DEPS_RUST_PRICING_SERVICE
envVars.description: The service endpoint of deps-rust-pricing (calls), one variable per member.

envVars.name: DEPS_RUST_SHOP_CALLERS
envVars.description: The callers field of deps-rust-shop: the issuers whose service credentials its server accepts, and the callers each vouches for, which a @requireService or @allowService operation checks. In a stack the http edges to deps-rust-shop derive it; outside one, set it. A list is a variable holding its length and each entry's members under its index; no issuers refuses every service credential.

envVars.name: DEPS_USERS_DB_DATABASE
envVars.description: The database connection of deps-users-db (authDb), one variable per member.
